rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for an Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Thrive Market team,

We are a small team dedicated to crafting engaging Instagram content that brings people together through food. We’d like to propose a collaborative post that highlights your commitment to supporting families in need, specifically your pledge to give every Thrive Market membership a free membership for a family in need. You're dedicated to sustainability through science-aligned carbon emission reductions, zero-waste warehouses, and plastic-neutral packaging, which you've detailed in Thrive Market's own website [P2]. Furthermore, Thrive Market's Multi-channel Content Machine Thrive Market is a subscription e-commerce business that specializes in delivering natural and organic foods, but at wholesale prices [P6]. We believe a collaborative Instagram post with Thrive Market, built together with your team, would be a great way to reinforce your values and showcase your commitment to sustainability. This post would focus on a single, visually appealing slide that invites your audience to share their favorite Thrive Market products and their families who benefit from the program.

The BrandPilot team
